hints.title: Neutralize Boundary-Connected Land
hints.text: Any land (0) connected to the grid boundary cannot be completely surrounded by water (1).

hints.title: Flood Fill Boundary Land First
hints.text: Traverse the outer perimeter rows and columns, turning all connected 0s into 1s using depth traversal.

hints.title: Count Enclosed Connected Components
hints.text: Scan internal cells; each remaining unvisited 0 initiates a guaranteed closed island that you flood-fill and count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to separate boundary-connected land requires tracking boundary escapes per connected component.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Pre-flooding the boundary simplifies island counting into standard connected components with O(M * N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that purging perimeter land eliminates boundary edge cases cleanly.
